objects.description: During [Operation Dream Job](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0022), [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) used an AES key to communicate with their C2 server.(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Jul 2020)
objects.description_fa: در طول [Operation Dream Job](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0022)، [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) از یک کلید AES برای برقراری ارتباط با سرور C2 خود استفاده کرد.(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Jul 2020)
